documents.title: PMIS Excel Pack — Reporting-Line Definitions Audit
documents.excerpt: 42 PMIS workbooks hold reporting-line logic that exists nowhere else. 11 lines are defined differently between Waitrose and John Lewis packs, forcing manual reconciliation every period.

documents.title: Waitrose Daily Sales Agent — Markdown Optimisation Results
documents.excerpt: Markdown and waste down 0.6pp across Fresh & Chilled since recommendations moved into the CoWork agent. Gold sales, stock and margin data refreshed daily.

documents.title: UK Consumer Confidence — Major Purchase Intentions
documents.excerpt: Major-purchase intentions fell for a third month. Grocery volumes resilient; discretionary home and electricals softer into Q4.

documents.title: Oracle Finance CDC — Landing Status in Snowflake
documents.excerpt: General ledger, AP and AR journals streaming into Snowflake within 15 minutes. Kooper procurement and DIDOS invoicing feeds live; Finance consumption still low.

documents.title: Estate Programme Board — Refurbishment Uplift Tracker
documents.excerpt: Refurbished Waitrose shops trading +6% vs control after 12 weeks. Two of three convenience planning consents secured; fit-out capacity confirmed for H1.

documents.title: National Living Wage Uplift — Partner Pay Impact
documents.excerpt: Confirmed pay floor rises above the budget assumption. Partner pay is the largest single cost line at GBP 1.9B.

documents.title: Meter Programme — Legacy Platform Exit Plan
documents.excerpt: Five legacy data platforms consolidating into Snowflake. Teradata and on-prem SQL Server licence exits planned for H2, saving GBP 17M a year.

documents.title: Price-Match Exposure — Electricals Black Friday Window
documents.excerpt: Price-match claims on TVs and laptops up 18% vs last year in the first two weeks of the promotional window. Margin at risk around GBP 14M per 1pp of markdown.

documents.title: Waitrose.com ODG — Basket and Substitution Trends
documents.excerpt: Average basket up 5% and substitution rate down after range rationalisation. Delivery-pass penetration improving margin mix.

documents.title: Scotland Footfall — Post Price-Rise Trend
documents.excerpt: Scottish shop footfall three weeks below forecast since the September price change. Recommend reviewing the 13-week profit index for the region.
